note: Date of service, per page: (1) the key/value extractor's date; (2) else a label below that starts within the first or last edge_words words of the page, with a date right after it (within label_reach_chars, only label_gap_words words between, so 'Visit Date: | DOB: 01/02/1960' is not a DOS) — an encounter label wins, else admit is From and discharge To; (3) else Azure OpenAI when enabled, on pages matching clinical_cues; (4) else a key/value date only its rules accepted, at low confidence (kv_low); (5) else no date. Each page keeps its own date and the Final DOS is the same. Edit labels here, not in dos_logic.py. Reloads on change.
note_default: DOS_DEFAULT_DATE is shown for a page with no date of its own (doc-level columns, review-ui downloads). It is never a page's Extracted DOS; it is the Final DOS of a stand-alone non-visit document (continuity_canon.json default_final_dos).
note_backup_max: backup_max caps every DOS that is not the key/value model's pick (edge label, LLM, the rules-only kv_low fallback), so a backup date always reads as low confidence. The model's pick keeps kv (capped only for spaced patterns).
note_kv_patterns: Rule 1b, kv_pattern: only when the key/value model chose no date for the page, a date after a DOS key read with spaced slashes ('05 / 20 / 2025', capped at kv_spaced), else with spaces only ('06 12 24', right after the key, capped at kv_spaces_only). These patterns are never the model's candidates.
note_edge_spaced: edge_spaced: the edge-keyword confidence when the date was read with spaced slashes ('05 / 20 / 2025'), a looser pattern than '05/20/2025'.
note_kv_low: Rule 4, last resort: when the key/value model chose no date for a page and the LLM found none, the date its rules accepted (best model score first) is used, match_type kv_low. Its confidence is the model's own probability (below the DOS threshold, so low), capped at backup_max; kv_low here is used only when that score is missing.
note_cues: Regex patterns. clinical_cues gates the Azure OpenAI fallback; discharge_cues makes it ask for admission and discharge dates.
